name: agent-workbench
description: Portable task orchestration, safe loop discovery, and opt-in pull-request evidence preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Route work, discover loops, and draft PR evidence
interface.longDescription: Agent Workbench coordinates bounded, independently verified subagent work, discovers recurring work that may suit safe agent loops, and prepares privacy-safe pull-request evidence locally before any separately authorized GitHub mutation.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Workbench to orchestrate this task through bounded subagents.
Use Agent Workbench to discover recurring work and draft a safe loop proposal.
Use Agent Workbench to prepare a local, privacy-safe pull-request evidence receipt.
